This repository distributes the Zoho Flow Custom Class SDK, not the Zoho Flow Agent implementation. Java is the only currently available language. Follow `AGENTS.md`, `sdk/java/docs/java-api.md`, and the closest relevant SDK guide. Compile against `ZFAgentCustom.jar` and `json.jar`, but never package those JARs in a connector upload ZIP. Do not invent Python or Node.js support, undocumented SDK APIs, Agent compatibility ranges, or finalized licensing terms.
